info.title: Cheerful Squirrels API
info.description:
REST API for the Cheerful Squirrels application (auth, users, articles).

### Response envelope
Every **successful** response (except `204 No Content`) has this shape:
```json
{ "status": 200, "message": "Human readable message", "data": { } }
```

Every **generic error** (thrown as an `http-errors` instance, or the multer
file-size limit) is handled by `errorHandler` and has this shape:
```json
{ "status": 400, "message": "Human readable message", "data": null }
```

Every **request-validation error** (thrown by `celebrate`/Joi for body,
params, or query) is handled by `celebrate`'s `errors()` middleware and has
a **different** shape:
```json
{
  "statusCode": 400,
  "error": "Bad Request",
  "message": "Validation failed",
  "validation": {
    "body": {
      "source": "body",
      "keys": ["email"],
      "message": "\"email\" must be a valid email"
    }
  }
}
```

Any request that does not match any route falls through to
`notFoundHandler` and returns:
```json
{ "status": 404, "message": "Route not found", "data": null }
```

### Authentication
Auth is session-based via three `httpOnly` cookies set by
`/auth/register`, `/auth/login`, and `/auth/refresh`:
`sessionId`, `accessToken`, `refreshToken`. Protected routes require a
valid `sessionId` + `accessToken` pair (checked against the `Session`
collection). Access tokens live 15 minutes; refresh tokens live 24 hours —
call `/auth/refresh` to rotate them.

post.description:
Reads `sessionId` and `refreshToken` cookies, rotates the session, and
re-issues all three cookies. Does **not** use the `authenticate`
middleware — it works even after the access token has expired, as
long as the refresh token (24h TTL) is still valid.
